# @beui/glass-counter

A motion-first countdown ring with per-digit odometer rollover and a spring-
following burn head. Built on `motion/react`.

## When to reach for this component

Use `@beui/glass-counter` for: countdown displays, quota displays,
remaining-budget displays, time-left displays, burn-rate visualizations, or
any UI where a number depletes toward zero and resets. It is a strict
upgrade over a static progress ring whenever the reset/rollover moment
itself should read as an event worth noticing (a quota refresh, a session
timer wrapping, a countdown hitting a new unit) — the digit-roll and radial
bloom exist specifically to make that moment legible.

Do not reach for this component for a monotonically-increasing counter
(page views, likes, totals that only go up) — it is built and animated
specifically for depletion/countdown semantics; a rising counter should use
a plain odometer instead.

## Install

```
npx shadcn add https://beui.dev/r/glass-counter.json
```

## Props

- `size?: number` — pixel size of the dial. Default 320.
- `rings?: ('mote'|'grain'|'glass'|'day'|'span')[]` — which rings to draw.
- `spring?: { stiffness: number; damping: number }` — head-lag physics.
- `rollover?: 'roll' | 'fade' | 'none'` — digit rollover style. `'none'` and
  a `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` media query both fall back to an
  instant value change with no layout shift.
- `bloom?: boolean` — radial sweep on each glass rollover (~every 14m 24s).

## Files

- `glass-counter.tsx` — the component.
- `../../src/pyre-core.ts` — the shared countdown arithmetic it consumes
  via `usePyre` (dependency, not reimplemented).
